integrity: Proof uses exact rational cyclic-kernel identities and reproducible integer-polynomial Sturm calculations. Decimal root approximations do not certify root uniqueness. No external validation is claimed.
limitations: Exactly classifies all nonnegative timesteps only at 14 states. At larger dimension establishes the sharp diagonal-loss onset and an exact witness but does not give every positive interval. Applies to a uniform one-way cyclic generator and the unmodified second-order Richardson extrapolate only.
title: A fourteen-state diagonal barrier and reentrant positivity for extrapolated backward Euler on directed cycles
